name: screentimenepal
description: A lightweight static storefront for Netflix, Prime Video, Spotify, Claude, Gemini AI Pro and Duolingo Super plans in Nepal. Customers pick a plan, collect it in a bag stored in their browser, and send the order as a chat message on WhatsApp or Instagram. **This is not a payment gateway and does not activate subscriptions.**

scripts.test:syntax: node --check app.js && node --check config.js && node --check tests/playwright.mjs
